# External Adapter Reference

This directory is reserved for advanced optional adapter docs (PR-10a/10b/10c):

- `BEDROCK_ADAPTER.md` — `BedrockTraceAdapter` usage and alias-backed identity requirements
- `A2A_ADAPTER.md` — `A2AAdapter` usage, `TASK_STATE_*` validation, and gRPC rejection
- `OPENAI_AGENTS_ADAPTER.md` — `OpenAIAgentsAdapter` usage for host-owned `openai-agents` runs, wrapped-tool governance, and trace/approval binding

These are advanced follow-on material. Complete the local workflow quickstart first.
